preconditions.description: The number of digits n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of operations k must be between 0 and 1,000,000,000.

preconditions.expression: len(d) == n and all(d[i] in {'4', '7'} for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: The array d must have exactly n digits, all of which are either '4' or '7'.

postconditions.description: The output must be the string representation of the array d after k operations.

postconditions.expression: all(d[i] in {'4', '7'} for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The output must consist only of the digits '4' and '7'.
